resources.string: Cloud tasks belong to this Telegram account and are kept on the Zenlygram server. With your data consent the tasks on this device are copied to Cloud once.
Cloud tasks need this account to be linked to Zenlygram. Nothing has been uploaded.
Connected. Changes you make here are sent to the server; each one shows its state until the server confirms it.
No connection to the server. Your changes wait on this device and are sent when the connection returns.
This account is no longer linked to Zenlygram. Changes wait on this device and are not sent until the account is linked again.
This device’s Zenlygram sign-in has ended. Link the account again to continue; waiting changes are kept.
Cloud tasks are not available right now. Nothing has been lost; try again later.
Cloud tasks could not be opened on this device.
Cloud tasks for this account are closed. Reopen this screen after signing in.
Cloud tasks haven’t been loaded from the server yet.
No cloud tasks yet.\n\nCreate one. Tasks you had on this device are copied here once, automatically, after your data consent.
Delete the list “%1$s” on the server? Tasks in it are deleted with it. This can’t be undone.
Shared with you: only its owner can change the text, list and due date.
This text can’t be sent: it may be longer than cloud tasks allow, or start or end with spaces or invisible characters. Nothing was cut; change it to save.
Cloud tasks can’t store this due date. Choose another one or remove it.
This change can’t be sent as it is. Check the fields and try again.
Send an invitation for “%1$s” to %2$s (Telegram ID %3$s)? They can accept, decline or block you. Telegram does not send them a message about it.
Leave “%1$s”? It disappears from your cloud tasks; its owner keeps it.
Block %1$s? You will get no more task invitations from them.
Unblock %1$s? They can send you task invitations again.
Not sent yet; it will be tried again
Not sent: creating cloud tasks isn’t available for this account right now
Not sent: the server can’t accept this change
Not sent: this changed on the server in the meantime
Not sent: this change was set aside after an unexpected answer
Not sent: it no longer exists on the server
Not sent: it was made for another Zenlygram link of this account
Discard this change? It hasn’t been applied on the server and will be removed from this device.
Send your version again as a new change? It replaces what is on the server now if the server accepts it.
A task shared with you is no longer available.
Something you changed no longer exists on the server.
A change was dropped because the change it depended on was discarded.
This is still being changed. Try again in a moment.
This account’s cloud tasks are not available now (signed out or not linked). Nothing was changed.
This account’s Zenlygram link changed. Reopen Cloud tasks; nothing was changed.
Cloud tasks are still loading. Try again in a moment; nothing was changed.
This no longer exists. Nothing was changed.
Only the task’s owner can do this.
Tasks on this device changed meanwhile. Open the copy again to review it; nothing was copied.
Cloud tasks could not be saved on this device. Nothing was changed.
This could not be done. Nothing was changed; try again.
%1$d folders and %2$d tasks can be copied as they are. Your tasks on this device stay as they are.
New list with a name you choose
Copy is waiting to be sent
Can’t be copied as it is: %1$s
Waits for a choice for its folder
Its tasks go to the Cloud Inbox
Removed in Cloud — not copied again
%1$d tasks wait for a choice for this folder
the name doesn’t meet cloud rules
the description is longer than cloud tasks allow
the due date is outside what cloud tasks can store
These stay on this device (nothing is shortened to fit):
There is nothing on this device that can be copied now.
Added to the cloud queue: %1$d lists and %2$d tasks. %3$d stay only on this device. Each shows its state until the server confirms it.
Copies are sent to the Zenlygram server as cloud tasks of the account %1$s.
This account isn’t confirmed with Zenlygram yet. Changes are kept on this device and sync once it is.
Cloud tasks are off for this account (Data & consent).
Cloud sync stopped after you withdrew consent. This copy is read-only.
Cloud sync is paused while your data consent is being confirmed. Changes can’t be made right now.
A task you deleted had changed on another device, so it was kept.
A task copied from this device is no longer in Cloud. It was removed there.
This list changed on another device and now has %1$d tasks. Delete the list and all its tasks?
Only tasks that aren’t in Cloud yet are offered. Titles and notes that break the Cloud rules are trimmed or shortened in the copy; the tasks on this device stay as they are.
%1$d folders and %2$d tasks can be copied.
These can’t be copied and stay on this device:
%1$d tasks in it stay on this device
%1$d changes to your cloud tasks haven’t reached the server yet and will be lost if you log out now.
Copying your device tasks to Cloud continues the next time you sign in to this account.
